newsitem.title: UK: Britain gives extra emergency aid to Montserrat.
newsitem.headline: Britain gives extra emergency aid to Montserrat.

text.p: Britain said on Thursday it will give Montserrat a further 6.95 million pounds ($11.73 million) to help people hurt or made homeless by the volcanic eruption on the Caribbean island.
"We are taking emergency action to deal with the crisis in all its aspects," International Development Secretary Clare Short said in a statement.
Twenty-two people are dead or missing following the most serious eruption so far, on June 25, of the Soufriere Hills volcano on the tiny British colony in the eastern Caribbean.
Hundreds of other people have fled their homes, leaving behind devastated villages. Last month Britain brought in emergency help and sent aid worth 6.8 million pounds.
Short said Britain would provide a further 6.5 million pounds to help build emergency shelter for islanders, plus 450,000 pounds for emergency repair work on a temporary hospital.
"We are also drawing up an urgent package of options which will be put to the people of Montserrat to enable them to choose the best future for themselves in the face of this disaster," she said.
The island's population has dwindled to around 5,800 from about 11,000 when the volcano roared to life in July 1995. ($1=.5926 Pound)
